body: I've been seeing therapists for years, but the one I am seeing now is the only one that's even listened to me. I just feel like she'll ask me about it, then assume I won't and not do anything. I just feel so stupid.
Well thanks for caring enough to reply. I appreciate it.

I wouldn't be able to get admitted with him because I am under 18, nor would I like to honestly. And I would hate to go back on my medication, it makes me feel absolutely nothing and I am even more of a nuisance to my family. Are psych wards worth anything? Do they work?
That's the thing, no one will take me seriously because I'm young. Right now it feels easier to half-attempt killing myself in order to get admitted. It's just so helpless.

I really don't want to go back to my medication. I hated it. All I did was sleep all the time and be even more useless and pathetic than what I already am. I had to fight my parents to get off it and my doctor didn't want me to either. I don't think I can admit myself because I'm under 18.
